key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence improved perovskite reasoning and guided a contact-material choice that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers connect experimental controls, observations and mechanisms to better perovskite solar-cell designs.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,532 articles.
Adapt OpenPerov using linked strategies, controls, observations and mechanistic interpretations.
Evaluate scientific reasoning and experimentally test an AI-selected self-assembled monolayer contact.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash led 13 closed-book systems; the selected contact enabled 27.05% efficiency and 96.74% retention of steady-state reference efficiency after 1,000 h of dark thermal ageing at 85 °C.
watch_item: The reported material-design test is narrow, and dark thermal ageing does not establish durability under illuminated operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
